definitions.short: Imri , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H566. Imri אִמְרִי proper name, masculine 1. a man of Judah 1Chr 9:4 ; compare 2 Neh 3:2 (= tall? or eloquent? ).

occurrences.englishText: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
Next to him the men of Jericho built. Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.
